name: MHCMotifAtlas_get_allele_ligands
description: Retrieve the complete exact match set of naturally presented ligands for an MHC Motif Atlas allele with recoverable local pagination. Class II records include predicted binding cores. metadata.total_matches is exact; continue with next_offset while has_more is true. Optional sequence retrieval reports sequence_found/sequence_error instead of silently returning null on a partial failure.

allele.description: MHC allele in MHC Motif Atlas format. Class I example: 'A0101' (HLA-A*01:01), 'B0702'. Class II example: 'DRB1_01_01'.

mhc_class.description: 'I' for MHC class I or 'II' for MHC class II. Default 'I'.

include_sequence.description: If true, also fetch the per-allele MHC protein sequence (from MHC_I_sequences.txt / MHC_II_sequences.txt). Default false.

limit.description: Maximum ligand records on this page, 1-1000. Defaults to 100; invalid values are rejected.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into this allele's exact ligand set; continue with metadata.next_offset.
